d:
Rusi grihyuddh 20vin sadi ke sabse khuni daur men se ek hai. rus par qabze ke lie lenin ki red aarmi aur vait aarmi ke bich is berham jang ka asar yurop men aaj bhi hai.
Rus, 1917. zar nikolas dvitiy ke gaddi chhorte hi 300 sal purana romanof shasan khatm ho gaya. lenin apni patni nadezda krupskaya ke sath svitzarlaind se laute aur desh men kamyunist raj qayam karne men jut gae. lekin bolshevikon ke sath rus par dava karne vali ek aur taqat khari huee: vait aarmi.
